title: Looking back · phrase
subtitle: 「回想起來／事後回顧／回頭反思」，究竟是哪一種 looking back？
description: 「回想起來／事後回顧／回頭反思」，究竟是哪一種 looking back？

words.note: 使用者提供。in retrospect 是 looking back 最核心、最自然的正式近義表達之一，表示從現在回頭評估過去事件，通常帶有後來才看清某事的意味。
words.example: In retrospect, we should have tested the system more thoroughly.

exercises.original: Looking back, I realise that we moved too quickly.
exercises.zh: 回想起來，我意識到我們當時行動得太快。
exercises.upgrade: in retrospect · 回想起來；事後回顧

options.explanation: 本題的決定性線索是 a present reassessment of a past decision；這裡需要的是「從現在重新評估過去」，所以 in retrospect 最精確。
強調經過思考後重新考慮並得出判斷。 本題的決定性線索是 a present reassessment of a past decision；這裡需要的是「從現在重新評估過去」。因此 on reflection 雖與 looking back 有關，但語義焦點並不最吻合。
明確表示因知道後來結果而看清過去，常與 should have / obvious now 等搭配。 本題的決定性線索是 a present reassessment of a past decision；這裡需要的是「從現在重新評估過去」。因此 with hindsight 雖與 looking back 有關，但語義焦點並不最吻合。
強調較深入、較有分析性的回顧，常帶 learning / lessons / understanding。 本題的決定性線索是 a present reassessment of a past decision；這裡需要的是「從現在重新評估過去」。因此 reflecting on 雖與 looking back 有關，但語義焦點並不最吻合。
只表示回想以前，未必有判斷、後見之明或結論。 本題的決定性線索是 a present reassessment of a past decision；這裡需要的是「從現在重新評估過去」。因此 thinking about the past 雖與 looking back 有關，但語義焦點並不最吻合。
口語、個人化，常與 remember, laugh, first day, childhood 等回憶搭配。 本題的決定性線索是 a present reassessment of a past decision；這裡需要的是「從現在重新評估過去」。因此 when I think back 雖與 looking back 有關，但語義焦點並不最吻合。

falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者高度接近；in retrospect 更偏事後評價，而 looking back 也可以只是回憶。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON In retrospect, the plan was too ambitious. Looking back, I remember the old classroom.

falseSynonyms.word: looking back / thinking about the past
falseSynonyms.zh: thinking about the past 只需回想過去；looking back 有時還會包含後見之明或重新評估。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Thinking about the past, she remembered her first job. Looking back, she realised the decision had been risky.

falseSynonyms.zh: with hindsight 明確要求知道後來發生了什麼；普通 looking back 不一定有這一層。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON With hindsight, the warning signs were obvious. Looking back, I remember how excited we were.

falseSynonyms.zh: on reflection 強調經過思考後重新得出結論；looking back 可以只是敘述回憶。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON On reflection, I think we chose the wrong route. Looking back, I remember the journey clearly.

falseSynonyms.zh: remembering 是記得某個資訊／事件；looking back 更像主動回顧一段過去。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I remember his name. Looking back on that year, I learned a lot.

falseSynonyms.zh: looking behind 是實際把視線轉到身後；looking back 本課是比喻性的回顧過去。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She looked behind her. Looking back, the decision seems obvious.

falseSynonyms.zh: nostalgia 是對過去的懷念情緒；looking back 不一定帶懷舊或溫暖感情。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He felt nostalgia for his childhood. Looking back, the project clearly had problems.

falseSynonyms.zh: looking back 是片語；reflection 是名詞，可指反思、倒影或沉思，不能直接替換句法。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON After reflection, she changed her mind. Looking back, she understood the mistake.
